title: DocumentTypeClassifier softmax dump
description: Input contract produced by the Swift DocumentTypeClassifier test target running over the G8 corpus. Consumed by fit_temperature.py (Phase 3b). Pre-softmax logits are requested rather than post-softmax probabilities so the Python side can apply a learned temperature T numerically cleanly. Do not reimplement the classifier in Python to shortcut this dump.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the Swift test target that produced this dump (e.g., 'RedactionEngineTests.DoctypeSoftmaxDumpTests').

g8_corpus_seed.description: Seed of the G8 corpus this dump was produced from. Python side asserts this matches the corpus under --corpus.

classes.description: Class names in the order the logits array is indexed by.

documents.description: One entry per G8 document. Order is not constrained; Python joins by doc_id.

logits.description: Pre-softmax class logits in the order given by 'classes'. Unnormalised real numbers.
